task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 for ISS-0911. Design the fix -- ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0911-20260930/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json) found the Start Instance dialog's version-display lookup (InstanceBoardPage.tsx's onStartDefinitionNameChange, lines ~181-200) matches the typed name against a page-level useDefinitions({name: definitionName}) query result -- keyed on the URL filter, NOT the dialog's own local startDefinitionName input -- so it never refetches for what the user is actually typing and instead checks a single stale, default-paginated ACTIVE-definitions list.

web/src/api/definitions.ts already exports exactly the right primitive for this: `getActive: (name: string) => client.get<ProcessDefinition>('/api/v1/definitions/active/' + encodeURIComponent(name))` -- a direct exact-name lookup against the backend, not a client-side scan of a possibly-stale list. Design the fix around calling this directly from the dialog's name-change handler (debounced, since it fires per keystroke) instead of scanning definitionTypeahead.items. State: (1) the exact call site and control flow (when to call getActive, how to handle the debounce/race between rapid keystrokes -- e.g. an AbortController or a request-generation-counter guard so a stale in-flight response can't overwrite a newer one), (2) the loading/empty/error states the version field should show while the lookup is in flight vs. not-found vs. found, (3) whether definitionTypeahead (the page-level list) still has any other legitimate use in this component that must be preserved untouched. Write this as a design artefact at lib/letflow/design/iss0911-start-instance-dialog-exact-lookup.md -- TypeScript signatures/type shapes and control-flow description only, no full function bodies.
acceptance_criteria: the fix calls definitionsApi.getActive(name) (or an equivalent exact-match backend lookup) keyed on the dialog's own typed value, not the page-level filtered list
a race-guard against out-of-order async responses (rapid typing) is explicitly designed, not left implicit
the version field's loading/not-found/found states are all specified
no implementation code in the design doc -- signatures/shapes and control-flow prose only

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/iss0911-start-instance-dialog-exact-lookup.md. Design replaces onStartDefinitionNameChange's scan of definitionTypeahead.items (page-filter-scoped, root cause per Step 01) with a new useActiveDefinitionByName(name) hook (web/src/hooks/useDefinitions.ts) that calls definitionsApi.getActive(trimmedName) keyed on definitionKeys.active(trimmedName) -- the already-existing but previously-only-invalidated tenant-scoped key factory. The dialog debounces its own startDefinitionName (existing useDebounce hook, 300ms, matching DefinitionListPage.tsx's convention) before feeding it to the new hook. Race-guard (AC2): argued explicitly as structural, not an AbortController/generation-counter -- TanStack Query gives each distinct trimmed name its own cache entry/observer, so a late response for a superseded name can never overwrite the currently-subscribed key's data; AbortController is flagged as an out-of-scope efficiency-only addition (OQ-1) since web/src/api/client.ts's request() has no signal param today and wiring one is a shared-primitive change beyond this fix's owned_modules. UI states (AC3): a deriveVersionLookupState() pure function maps the query result to idle/loading/found/not_found/error (added 'error' beyond the AC's three named states, since a network/5xx failure must not be visually indistinguishable from a genuine 404), with a value/placeholder table for the start-definition-version input. Confirmed and documented (per task item 3) that definitionTypeahead keeps a legitimate remaining role -- backing the <datalist> the dialog input's list attribute still references for autocomplete suggestions -- and is left untouched. No implementation code included -- hook/type signatures and control-flow prose only (AC4).
